common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a finished Korean mobile app screen redesign concept, app content only.
Create realistic, production-quality UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. A focused primary home screen, not a feature inventory. Preserve CloudBoard's existing design language from the attached actual implementation screenshot: white #FFFFFF base, ink #202028, muted #777683, dusty lavender accent #77729D, pale selected #E4E1EE and thin divider #E6E3EF. Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif. Body 14–16px logical, titles 24px and section headings 18px. Familiar Material outlined icons, consistent weight. Small 12–16px corners, restrained surfaces, no gratuitous shadows or gradients. Thumbnail images remain small and support the list.
Target Dimensions: 390 x 844 logical app content, naturally portrait about 780 x 1688 output. Fill the entire rectangular canvas with app content at this aspect ratio. No device bezel, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock, battery, signal, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask, device shadow, presentation headings, outside annotations or numbered options. Current date anchor: 2026-10-10, Asia/Seoul. No calendar or fabricated metrics.
Source image is the actual previous home layout: use its logo, typography, lavender, grouped-list simplicity as grounding. Change the navigation and home hierarchy as specified; do NOT repeat its hamburger or OS chrome.
Keep top logo spelled exactly "CloudBoard", compact right search icon. Greeting exactly "코치님, 반가워요." with short display-status link. Header spacing 24px sides. Three sample workouts in a grouped list with subtle separators, thumbnail at left, readable title and metadata, time in bold, lavender play button and light overflow button at right. Rows: "WAVE ZONE" with "5개 슬라이드" and "30:00"; "STRENGTH" with "4개 슬라이드" and "24:00"; "COOL DOWN" with "2개 슬라이드" and "10:00". Existing waterfall/landscape thumbnail language. All mock content is sample UI, no customer data.
Avoid unnecessary panels, duplicate creation actions, huge heroes, advertisements, charts, gradients, decorative illustrations, or adding invented features. Use spacing, grouping, typography and fine dividers before tinted surfaces or shadows. Bottom navigation icons must have always-visible Korean labels, selected destination visible by both a pale lavender indicator and stronger text. Touch regions approximately 48px or larger. Keep plenty of usable list space and no overlaps.

variants.fixed:
Concept name: 고정형 네 개 목적지.
Redesign the attached CloudBoard home with a fixed full-width white bottom navigation bar, subtle top divider, equal FOUR tabs. Exact labels left-to-right: "홈", "라이브러리", "디스플레이", "더보기". Icons respectively home, layered slides, desktop monitor, horizontal ellipsis. "홈" selected in lavender with a small pale pill behind only the icon. Bar aligned to lower canvas, roughly 72px content height and 16px quiet padding below labels, no system home indicator.
At top use logo and search, no hamburger and no avatar. Greeting below. Exact status "디스플레이 연결하기" plus monitor icon and small chevron. List heading "워크아웃 3개", small right aligned "모든 폴더" dropdown. Three compact workout rows with enough blank space below to breathe.
One prominent rounded lavender + FAB only, 56x56 logical, lower right 20px from edge and 16px ABOVE the tab bar, entirely separate from tabs. Idle, no active playback controller. This direction emphasizes direct access to all four areas with the smallest change to the established home.
variants.dock:
Concept name: 수업 제어가 분리된 도크.
Redesign the attached home with a floating white navigation dock inset 16px from left and right, thin lavender-grey outline, soft subtle elevation, 24px corners, positioned near bottom with 16px outer bottom margin, no OS indicator. FOUR equally spaced tabs, labels exactly "홈", "라이브러리", "디스플레이", "더보기"; home/layered-slides/desktop-monitor/ellipsis icons; "홈" selected.
Top logo and search, no hamburger. Below greeting and exact compact status "디스플레이 1대 연결됨" (sample active-class state). List header "워크아웃 3개" with small filled lavender button "+ 만들기" on right. "모든 폴더" filter as a small text dropdown above rows. No floating + FAB: creation exists only in the heading.
Show active class mini controller as a separate slim lavender-tinted bar directly ABOVE floating nav with 8px gap and same 16px horizontal inset, never overlapping. Small thumbnail left, exact title "WAVE ZONE", subline "운동 · 12:34", large pause icon button right and chevron expand action. A very thin progress line across its top. This controller is for existing active class, not a new workout card. Leave breathing space between list and the mini controller. Three workout rows as specified, no additional dashboard cards. This concept shows clear vertical separation of content, active class controls, and navigation.
variants.three:
Concept name: 세 목적지 중심의 경량형.
Redesign attached home with a fixed full-width white bottom navigation bar, thin top divider, exactly THREE broad tabs with equal widths. Labels exactly "홈", "라이브러리", "디스플레이". Icons home, layered slides, desktop monitor. Home selected with pale lavender icon indicator and bold purple label. Bar roughly 76px high with a little quiet bottom padding, no OS indicator. No fourth tab.
Top toolbar "CloudBoard" left; compact search icon and a neutral small outlined circular person avatar button at far right. Avatar is entrance to account and store settings, not an added social feature. No hamburger.
Greeting "코치님, 반가워요." and status "디스플레이 연결하기". Section heading "워크아웃 3개"; below it a single very compact utility row with left "모든 폴더" dropdown and right lavender text/icon "+ 만들기". Three grouped workout rows as specified. No FAB. Avoid cards: ample white surface, fine row separators. This direction gives three frequent destinations larger tap zones, while profile/store entry remains at the top. Idle state, no active playback mini controller.
